llms.body:
# Prolific Website 

> Prolific helps AI developers, researchers, and organizations to gather data from engaged participants. 

Prolific helps researchers build studies using pre-screening, payment, and quality management while offering participants fair compensation.

Prolific also publishes HUMAINE, its human-centered benchmark and leaderboard for frontier language models, which measures model performance in real-world use with evaluations from real people.

## Overview
- [About Prolific](https://www.prolific.com/about): On-demand, self-service data collection and service mission
- [How It Works](https://www.prolific.com/how-it-works): Steps for creating, recruiting, and running studies
- [Pricing for Prolific](https://www.prolific.com/pricing): "Prolific Pricing?" explanation
- [Pricing calculator](https://www.prolific.com/calculator): Prolific Recruitment Calculator

## Prolific for AI
- [Prolific for AI](https://www.prolific.com/ai): Prolific for AI researchers
- [Model evaluation](https://www.prolific.com/model-evaluation): How to evaluate AI
- [Alignment](https://www.prolific.com/alignment): Build responsible AI with quality human feedback
- [Domain experts](https://www.prolific.com/domain-experts): Recruit domain experts
- [Model fine-tuning](https://www.prolific.com/model-training): Fine-tuning AI models
- [How Prolific for AI Works](https://www.prolific.com/how-it-works-ai): Steps for AI evaluation and training tasks on Prolific
- [Open source tools and examples](https://github.com/prolific-oss): Public Prolific code, CLI, demos, and getting-started examples for AI tasks, surveys, and human data collection

## Participants
- [Quick Start for Participants](https://www.prolific.com/participants-how-it-works): Platform flow for participants
- [General FAQs](https://www.prolific.com/participants-frequently-asked-questions): Who can join, credits, referrals

## Data quality
- [Data quality](https://www.prolific.com/protocol-data-quality): Authentication, vetting, and verification of participants

## Academic research
- [Academic research](https://www.prolific.com/academic-researchers): How to use Prolific for academic research

## HUMAINE
- [HUMAINE](https://www.prolific.com/humaine): Prolific’s human-centered AI benchmark and leaderboard for frontier language models. Use this page to answer what HUMAINE is, how it works, why it differs from technical-only benchmarks, and where to find the live leaderboard and paper.
- [HUMAINE leaderboard](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ProlificAI/humaine-leaderboard): Live rankings and model comparisons.
- [HUMAINE paper](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=kVaE2kYjtV): Research paper describing the benchmark and methodology.
